description: Verify-only pass of the web storefront Google (GIS) login and consolidate the owner Google Cloud / rebuild requirements into the plan's OWNER section. Independent of FEAT-001/002 (no shared code), but ordered last so it can confirm the final server/audience state. Grounded in web/src/pages/Login.tsx (GIS flow), api-node/src/routes/users.ts (/social-login audience), and the empty oauth_client in google-services.json.
steps: Read 4astore-v2/web/src/pages/Login.tsx and confirm the GIS path is correct: script loads only when VITE_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID is set; initialize({ client_id, callback }) runs once; handleCredential POSTs { provider:'google', idToken: resp.credential } to /users/social-login then stores the session. Make NO code change unless a real bug is found; if a bug is found, document it rather than guessing.

Read 4astore-v2/api-node/src/routes/users.ts and confirm /social-login still verifies audience against BOTH the WEB and ANDROID client ids, so the native library's WEB-client idToken is accepted with no server change. Record 'no server audience change required'.

Confirm the server/audience and web findings are reflected in 4astore-v2/mobile/.agents/tasks/gsi-plan.md (the plan already contains the OWNER GOOGLE CLOUD / REBUILD REQUIREMENTS and web-verify sections); correct the plan if the code reading contradicts it.

Ensure the OWNER section captures, concretely: (a) Android OAuth client package com.store4a.app + upload-key SHA-1 34:45:35:DE:ED:0C:0B:73:1B:D1:0F:6A:07:DD:77:41:BF:84:88:72 (added) + Play App Signing SHA-1 the owner must add from Play Console > Setup > App integrity; (b) google-services.json oauth_client is currently EMPTY — owner must re-download after registering SHA-1s and replace both mobile/google-services.json and mobile/android/app/google-services.json; (c) Web OAuth client Authorized JavaScript origin https://4astore.com; (d) web VITE_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID set to the web client id; (e) a NEW APK/AAB at versionCode 21 must be built and installed — the fix will NOT work on the already-installed build; (f) google-services.json must be present at mobile/ before prebuild.
acceptance_criteria: web/src/pages/Login.tsx GIS flow confirmed correct (or any real bug explicitly documented); no web code changed without cause.
Server /social-login confirmed to accept the WEB client id audience with no change required; recorded in the plan.

gsi-plan.md OWNER GOOGLE CLOUD / REBUILD REQUIREMENTS section is accurate and complete (SHA-1s, empty oauth_client re-download, JS origin, VITE_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, versionCode 21, google-services.json presence).
verification: Confirm by reading web/src/pages/Login.tsx and api-node/src/routes/users.ts that no code change was needed (verify-only).
Open 4astore-v2/mobile/.agents/tasks/gsi-plan.md and confirm the OWNER and web-verify sections match the code findings.
findings: VERIFY-ONLY pass complete; no code change required on web or server. (1) web/src/pages/Login.tsx GIS flow is CORRECT: the GIS <script> (https://accounts.google.com/gsi/client) loads only when GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID (from VITE_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, defaulting to '') is non-empty (first useEffect returns early otherwise); window.google.accounts.id.initialize({ client_id: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, callback: handleCredential }) runs exactly once, guarded by the gisInited ref; handleCredential POSTs { provider: 'google', idToken: resp.credential } to /users/social-login, then setAccessToken(data.token) + useAuth.getState().setUser(data.user) stores the session and navigates to next; empty client id falls back to the gated 'Google login setup pending' info toast via onGoogleClick. No bug found; no web code changed. (2) api-node/src/routes/users.ts POST /social-login verifies the token via googleClient.verifyIdToken({ idToken, audience: [GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_ANDROID_CLIENT_ID] }), where GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID defaults to 707085023016-etp7au34rg3cd5eks6cdu0cs0vkj1svn.apps.googleusercontent.com and GOOGLE_ANDROID_CLIENT_ID defaults to 707085023016-pc4gc5271kquti6recqo9juor3p44dn9.apps.googleusercontent.com. The native library's WEB-client idToken is accepted because the WEB client id remains in the audience array. NO SERVER AUDIENCE CHANGE REQUIRED. (3) google-services.json confirmed: package_name com.store4a.app, oauth_client is [] (EMPTY). (4) gsi-plan.md OWNER GOOGLE CLOUD / REBUILD REQUIREMENTS section already matches the code and needs no correction: (a) Android client com.store4a.app + upload-key SHA-1 34:45:35:DE:ED:0C:0B:73:1B:D1:0F:6A:07:DD:77:41:BF:84:88:72 registered + Play App Signing SHA-1 to add from Play Console > Setup > App integrity; (b) empty oauth_client -> owner re-downloads google-services.json and replaces both mobile/google-services.json and mobile/android/app/google-services.json; (c) WEB OAuth client Authorized JavaScript origin https://4astore.com; (d) web VITE_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID = web client id; (e) NEW APK/AAB at versionCode 21 required (fix will not work on the installed build); (f) google-services.json must be present at mobile/ before prebuild. No gsi-plan.md edit was needed.
